objective: Read the Hallowed Tablet and speak to Ken'jai outside the Den in the Valley of Trials.

description: Ah, while you were gone a tablet came for you, <name>.
Read it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the priest trainer Ken'jai. He would have words with you when you're ready.
progress: So ya made it... good good! Da spirits tol' me you be comin' to see Ken'jai soon enough. Let me be one o' da first to welcome ya to da Valley of Trials. Dis place not be your home fer long, but while it is, why dontcha make da best o' it.
completion: As ya test yeself, ya'll find ya have better an' better control o'er da spirits--ya'll be callin' on dem fer greata an' greata tings... dat's where ol' Ken'jai come in. You come talk to ole Ken'jai when ya feel yer ready. If da spirits agree, den we see 'bout teachin' ya more powerful abilities... but only if da spirits agree.
Go now, talk to da rest of da Valley's people. Speak to me again later.
